profile_text.body:
Twilio describes itself as a platform for building customer experiences, offering APIs for SMS, RCS, voice, and email alongside conversational AI and identity verification. The company says the platform connects communication channels, customer context, and AI in one place, with flexible plans and pay-as-you-go pricing. It also describes AI agents that draw on internal knowledge and real-time data, and that hand conversations to human staff when complexity or customer intent calls for it, transferring full context so customers do not repeat themselves.

Twilio is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, traded under the ticker TWLO, with CIK 0001447669.

Its litigation exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.
